title: Trace every scenario to a test, and finish the open must-do task

expected.says: Run's report for the tiny portfolio matches the expected report

blueprint.contract: A new function. `test_` followed by the scenario's name in lower case, with each run of characters other than `a`-`z` and `0`-`9` replaced by one `_`, and no `_` at either end of the name part: the scenario `A must-do is refused!` gives `test_a_must_do_is_refused`.
blueprint.idea: The link between a scenario and its test is a naming convention the checker can check.

lesson.title: 14.4.6 Living Specs: Every Scenario Traced to a Test, Every Test to a Scenario

blueprint.contract: Reads every scenario of `root/openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md` and expects its test, named by `test_name`, in `root/tests/test_<capability>.py` with each `-` of the capability written as `_` (`capital-plan` gives `tests/test_capital_plan.py`). Reads the module-level test functions (named `test_...`) of those files with `ast`, without importing them; other test files are ignored. Returns `Trace(pairs, untested, untraced)`: the number of scenarios whose test was found, the sorted `<capability>: <scenario>` labels with no test, and the sorted `tests/<file>::<test>` names that match no scenario of their own file's capability.
blueprint.idea: A scenario is matched to a test in its own capability's file only; a test of the same name elsewhere does not count.
